-- Find tiotropium (a common LAMA long-acting bronchodilator) concept ID
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tiotropium%'
  AND domain_id IN ('Drug', 'Medication')
LIMIT 10;

I already found tiotropium concept IDs in the previous turn. Now let me count COPD patients who received it by joining drug_exposure with condition_occurrence.

arguments.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.subject_id) AS copd_patients_on_tiotropium FROM omop.drug_exposure de INNER JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON de.subject_id = co.subject_id INNER JOIN omop.concept c_con ON co.condition_concept_id = c_con.concept_id INNER JOIN omop.concept c_drug ON de.drug_concept_id = c_drug.concept_id WHERE LOWER(c_con.concept_name) LIKE '%copd%' AND c_drug.concept_id IN (790206, 790207, 858238, 858239, 858240, 858241, 858242)

content.text: I need to check the actual column names in the OMOP tables for this specific database, since `subject_id` isn't valid here. Let me inspect a few rows.
The column is `person_id`, not `subject_id`. Let me fix the query.

arguments.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS copd_patients_on_tiotropium FROM omop.drug_exposure de INNER JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON de.person_id = co.person_id INNER JOIN omop.concept c_con ON co.condition_concept_id = c_con.concept_id INNER JOIN omop.concept c_drug ON de.drug_concept_id = c_drug.concept_id WHERE LOWER(c_con.concept_name) LIKE '%chronic obstructive pulmonary disease%' AND c_drug.concept_id IN (790206, 790207, 858238, 858239, 858240, 858241, 858242)
